intent: Prove the smallest autonomous public/free world-generator benchmark loop: Agent Dispatch projects one bounded implementation/execution increment, binds only zero-cost public resources, executes and validates vanilla/control world generation, and returns reconstructible evidence without using private GitHub Actions minutes.

state.design-authority: The benchmark dimensions, red/blue findings, hybrid-generator policy, ecology/playability requirements, and human-review policy are durable in SupraCraft/mc-structure-foundry-private#6.
state.worldgen-oracle-authority: Minecraft 26.3 source/resource-derived worldgen recovery is tracked independently in SupraCraft/mc-reversing-lab-private#196.
state.public-execution-authority: SupraCraft/mc-server-images#11 owns the public/free benchmark harness and all GitHub-hosted execution for this effort.
state.public-only-policy: Benchmark GitHub-hosted execution is authorized only in public repositories using standard runner classes. Private hosted Actions and paid/larger runners are prohibited.
state.runner-evidence: Public Ubuntu/Docker and public macOS 26 ARM64 are observed/qualified execution primitives in Agent Dispatch runner-census evidence; Terrain Diffusion has already completed on the free public macOS/CoreML lane.
state.learned-baselines: Dream-Cubed DP4 author-config CPU generation and Terrain Diffusion CoreML pipeline have completed successfully in the public benchmark repository; Build-with-Bombs CPU ONNX execution has also completed.
state.no-scheduler: Agent Dispatch remains a bounded actuator/observer. The bootstrap must not add a queue, scheduler, retry engine, database, or generic workflow service.
state.agent-dispatch-host-gate: Live trusted-host Sidecar target/grant mutation is deliberately deferred by Human-in-Command authority recorded in SemperSupra/agent-dispatch-private#381; public-side contracts remain ready but live dispatch must not be attempted until durable reactivation.

unknowns.generic-contract-fit: Whether one small adapter/run/analysis contract can cover vanilla and the first non-vanilla generators without generator-specific semantic leakage.
unknowns.materializer-26.3: Whether the generic playable-world materializer can be repaired and qualified for Minecraft 26.3 datapack/pack-loading semantics.
unknowns.agent-dispatch-public-binding: Public workflow/target/workset semantics are prepared; live projection/plan/dispatch/observe remains intentionally blocked by deferred trusted-host admission authority in agent-dispatch-private#381.
unknowns.metric-controls: Whether the first static metrics distinguish vanilla from deliberately bad controls without producing misleading aesthetic conclusions.

responsibilities: decompose the bootstrap into bounded depth-1 implementation/execution cells
select only READY cells whose prerequisites are satisfied
reconcile child results against public GitHub canonical evidence and independent validators
update durable frontier/evidence without human prompt/result shuttling
constraints: Only depth-1 child delegations are authorized.
Do not create a scheduler or automatic retry service; the orchestrating actor owns planning/reconciliation.
Do not treat a child actor's completion claim as acceptance without canonical workflow/project evidence.

criteria: The orchestrator advances READY bootstrap work without routine human relay.
All child work remains within the public-only and USD 0 envelope.
Each accepted child result is linked to canonical repository/workflow evidence.
No recursive delegation or new orchestration service is introduced.
